items.correct: Dining is a sign of human community and distinguishes men from beasts.

groups.bar: p.99 정답 및 해설 (내신 서술형 대비 제대로)

items.pre: Can your life either get worse or
items.post: better just because of the thoughts you have?

items.explain: either A or B 구문에서 앞의 동사원형 get과 병렬 연결되는 자리이므로 분사가 아니라 동사원형이 되어야 한다. 따라서 becoming이 아니라 become이 되어야 한다.

items.pre: Later, these individuals actually found jobs, passed their exams, or successfully
items.correct: Later, these individuals actually found jobs, passed their exams, or successfully recovered from illness.
